description: Operating Cost Reduction of DC Microgrids Under Real-Time Pricing Using Adaptive Differential Evolution Algorithm is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yun Yang (The University of Hong Kong). These data are collected from a 12-bus and a 32-bus DC microgrid. The total operating cost of these two microgrids are optimized by an adaptive Differential Evolution algorithm using real-time pricing. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
